parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm enable.explanation: 启用连接故障管理(CFM)协议。

set protocols cfm domain md1 level 3.command: set protocols cfm domain md1 level 3

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 domain md1
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置维护关联(MA)及其所属的CFM域。

parameters.name: domain
parameters.explanation: 维护关联所属的CFM域名称。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] continuity-check interval [parameter2]
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 continuity-check interval 10
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置连续性检查的间隔时间。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查的间隔时间，单位为毫秒。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] continuity-check loss-threshold [parameter2]
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 continuity-check loss-threshold 3
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置连续性检查的丢失阈值。

parameters.name: loss-threshold
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查的丢失阈值。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] continuity-check send-only
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 continuity-check send-only
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置连续性检查为仅发送模式。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 service evpna
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置维护关联的服务类型。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] mep [parameter2] interface [parameter3] [parameter4]
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 interface ge-1/0/1 inward
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置维护端点(MEP)及其接口和方向。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 维护端点所在的接口名称。

parameters.name: direction
parameters.explanation: 维护端点的方向，可以是'inward'或'outward'。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] mep [parameter2] continuity-check enable
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 continuity-check enable
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 启用维护端点的连续性检查。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] mep [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 remote-mep 1
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置维护端点的远程维护端点。

parameters.name: remote-mep
parameters.explanation: 远程维护端点的标识符。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] mep [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] ccm-receive enable
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 remote-mep 1 ccm-receive enable
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 启用维护端点接收来自远程维护端点的连续性检查消息(CCM)。

parameters.name: remote-mep
parameters.explanation: 远程维护端点的标识符。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] mep [parameter2] delay-measure test-id [parameter3] one-way receive
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 delay-measure test-id 1 one-way receive
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置维护端点的单向延迟测量接收。

set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-association [parameter1] mep [parameter2] delay-measure test-id [parameter3] remote-mep [parameter4] one-way interval [parameter5]
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 delay-measure test-id 3 remote-mep 1 one-way interval 1000
set protocols cfm maintenance-associatio.explanation: 配置维护端点的单向延迟测量发送间隔。

parameters.name: remote-mep
parameters.explanation: 远程维护端点的标识符。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 发送间隔时间，单位为毫秒。

set routing-instances evpna vrf-target e.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF导出目标。

parameters.explanation: VRF目标，用于控制路由的导入和导出。
